title: The trail
steps: The trial is over, and in the hall there are three creatures that did not exist this morning. Orla closes the book.
Look after them. They are the closest creature you will ever have.
Give its name only to those you trust completely…
…for whoever knows its name can summon it and give it orders.
Now you may go, and I am off to teach the third-years how to conjure unicorns.
And she goes down to fetch the next class.
{familiar} will not leave {friend}'s pocket alone.
Hey! What is it, {familiar}? That's the pocket where I keep the black threads we found at the start of the year.
The creature shoots across the hall like an arrow and slips into a tiny arch at the foot of the wall. You can hear it moving inside the wall.
It comes back carrying something: a black thread, exactly like the ones you found.
Oh, I've read about this in *Lies and Truths about Arvelia*, by the renowned wizard Juni Tamari.
The castle is full of small passages…
…made so that familiars can move quickly from one place to another…
…without disturbing the rest of the castle's dwellers.
They are so narrow that only a small animal fits through them.
Well, I'm sure that at the other end of that passage is whoever set the trap with the brooms.
And if we find him, we'll have the proof we need to talk to Orla.
You go down a floor. In the corridor under the hall there are two tiny entrances at the foot of the wall, small as cat flaps.
I think {familiar} came down that way, but where did it find the thread?
{familiar} slips into the other entrance.
It is out again at once with another black thread: in there is where it found the first.
Not even my head fits. I think we'll have to send our familiars.
